g.title: Note
g.text: External actors are repeated only for readability (same system).
Include / extend link only use cases of the same package; “Send email” appears in every package that uses it.
Payment: startPayment checks the hold BEFORE charging; if it expired the payment is rejected and the card is not charged.
Issue tickets (extend): payment is confirmed by Stripe webhook, not by the browser.
Release seats (extend): 10 minutes elapsed, but not while a started payment is in progress (5 min grace).
Reservation: at most 8 tickets per user per event (TicketLimitExceededException); seat taken = 409.
Cancel: allowed before COMPLETED even with sold tickets; delete: only with no tickets sold.
A PENDING organizer may create a DRAFT; publishing needs an approved (ACTIVE) account. Code has approval only; rejection is a target.
Sprint 2 code: every event has a hall and seats, so seat selection is «include».
QR validation is done by the organizer (TICKET_VALIDATE); no separate actor.
